cards.title: Lobby — NovaCloud HQ
cards.description:
A sunlit lobby. A neon sign hums: "NovaCloud — Built on AWS. Powered by caffeine." On the opposite wall, a second neon sign reads: "NovaCloud — Powering Ideas Since 2006." The receptionist's desk is empty. A note taped to the monitor reads: "Be right back — coffee machine triggered an alarm. -Kim." On the wall: a fragmented WELCOME poster, scrambled tiles waiting to be solved. Somewhere in here is the desk you've been assigned.

Your orientation buddy Alex left a sticky on the door: "Solve the poster, learn your bay. Trust me. -A"
cards.image_prompt: Bright modern startup lobby, glass walls, neon AWS-orange accent sign reading 'NovaCloud', clean minimalist reception desk, scattered welcome balloons, fragmented welcome poster on wall, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Welcome Poster
cards.description: A 9-tile poster scrambled into nonsense. Once it reads correctly, the poster will display your desk assignment.
cards.flavor_text: Blue cards are things you interact WITH.
cards.image_prompt: Scrambled corporate welcome poster, 9 jumbled puzzle tiles, AWS-orange and white color scheme, sticker-style icons of cloud, key, badge, mug

cards.title: Desk Assignment Slip
cards.description:
Welcome to NovaCloud!

Name: YOU
Desk: 7B
Bay: VPC-3
IAM PIN: the year AWS launched

(IT will scream if you lose this. — HR)
cards.flavor_text: Red cards are things you USE. Bring this to Security.
cards.image_prompt: Crisp printed onboarding slip on bright paper, NovaCloud logo header, fields filled in marker, holographic security strip, top-down view

cards.title: Onboarding Step 1: Complete.
cards.description: The poster snaps into place. "WELCOME TO VPC-3, DESK 7B." A panel slides aside in the back wall, revealing a corridor to IT Setup. The HR system pings: "Step 1 complete. Proceed to IT."

cards.title: Jeff B's Lost Mug
cards.description:
A chipped mug, half-hidden behind welcome balloons. Faded Sharpie: "PROPERTY OF JEFF B. DO NOT LOSE." Inside: a dried tea bag and a sticker that reads "Day 1."

Lore: NovaCloud's founders inherited this mug from a previous startup. Nobody knows who Jeff is. Everyone's afraid to throw it out.
cards.image_prompt: Chipped white ceramic mug with faded sharpie marker text, dried tea bag inside, slightly sad lighting, single object on dark background

cards.title: IT Setup — EC2 Workstation Bay
cards.description:
A row of identical desks. One has a sticker that reads "7B" — yours. A laptop sits closed on the desk, lid sealed shut by a tangle of unplugged cables. A handwritten sign on the wall: "CONNECT YOUR EC2 WORKSTATION. WIRES MATTER. CABLE MANAGEMENT IS NOT OPTIONAL. — IT."

A small bundle of color-coded cables is coiled on the desk.
cards.image_prompt: Open-plan startup IT bay, rows of standing desks, one desk highlighted with sticker '7B', tangle of network cables, monitors, AWS-themed posters, fluorescent overhead lights, isometric digital illustration

discoveries.label: Open the laptop and connect cables

cards.title: Your Laptop (EC2-7B)
cards.description: A standard-issue laptop. Stickers: "NOVACLOUD" / "I 💜 LAMBDAS" / "TURN IT OFF AND ON AGAIN." Four ports glow softly, waiting for the right cables.
cards.image_prompt: Modern laptop covered in tech stickers, four glowing colored ports on the side, dark cyberpunk-startup aesthetic, neon highlights

cards.title: Cable Bundle
cards.description: Four cables: green (Power), blue (Data), gray (Ground), orange (Network). Each labeled in tiny print. They want to be plugged in.
cards.image_prompt: Bundle of four color-coded computer cables, green blue gray orange, neatly coiled, single object on dark background, neon highlights

cards.title: Onboarding Step 2: Complete.
cards.description: The laptop boots. NovaCloud logo. A Slack notification: "Welcome aboard! Frank's expecting you in Security to activate your badge. Bring your desk slip." A door opposite slides open.

cards.title: Security Office — IAM Checkpoint
cards.description:
A small office, suspiciously tidy. Behind the desk: Frank — Head of Security. Stern. He does not smile. Above his head: a poster that reads "LOOSE LIPS SINK LAMBDAS." On the desk: a badge terminal with a 4-digit keypad. Frank speaks without looking up: "Slip. Keypad. PIN. In that order. Don't make me explain IAM."

(Your IAM PIN is on your Desk Assignment Slip — but you'll need to remember the year AWS launched.)
cards.image_prompt: Sparse security office interior, gray desk with badge terminal and keypad, stern poster reading 'LOOSE LIPS SINK LAMBDAS', single bald guard silhouetted, fluorescent lighting, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Badge Terminal
cards.description: A glass podium with a 4-digit keypad and a slot for a fresh badge. The screen reads: "ENTER IAM PIN."
cards.image_prompt: Sleek glass security terminal with glowing 4-digit keypad and badge slot, AWS-orange accent light, single object on dark background

cards.title: Activated Badge
cards.description: Your badge, freshly minted. Photo: a startled blur. Status: ACTIVE. Tier: ONBOARDING. Frank stamps it twice and slides it across the desk without making eye contact.
cards.image_prompt: Crisp employee badge on lanyard, NovaCloud logo, holographic security strip, slightly blurred ID photo, single object on dark background

cards.title: Onboarding Step 3: Complete.
cards.description: The keypad chirps. The terminal prints your badge. Frank, almost smiling: "You'll do. Break Room's down the hall — go meet Alex before they drink all the cold brew." A door clicks open behind you.

cards.title: Loose Lips Sink Lambdas
cards.description:
A laminated poster, peeling at the corners. "LOOSE LIPS SINK LAMBDAS. Don't paste credentials in Slack. Don't email keys. Don't write passwords on sticky notes. (Looking at you, Marcus.) — Frank."

Lore: Frank designed this poster himself in PowerPoint over a weekend. He is very proud of it.
cards.image_prompt: Laminated wartime-style propaganda poster reading 'LOOSE LIPS SINK LAMBDAS', cartoon lambda function symbol sinking into ocean, peeling corners, single object on dark background

cards.title: Break Room — The Lambda Café
cards.description:
Mid-century modern break room. A coffee machine hums proudly, plastered in stickers: "Lambda-powered. Brew time: 200ms." A cold-brew tap labeled "S3 Cold Storage." A whiteboard covered in barely-readable scribbles.

At a corner table, your orientation buddy Alex waves you over with both hands.
cards.image_prompt: Cozy startup break room, mid-century furniture, espresso machine covered in stickers, whiteboard wall, cold-brew tap labeled 'S3', warm lighting, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Alex (Orientation Buddy)
cards.description: Alex — your orientation buddy, energy drink in one hand, sticky notes in the other. They've prepared. Aggressively.
cards.image_prompt: Cheerful 20-something tech employee in casual hoodie holding energy drink, sticky notes stuck to sleeve, friendly smile, single character portrait on dark background

cards.title: Alex's Boot Sequence Note
cards.description:
Alex hands you a sticky note with the boot order for the S3 Locker, scrawled fast:

"IAM first — auth before anything fun. Then VPC — gotta have a network. EC2 — your workstation. S3 — storage. Lambda — the fun stuff."

"Memorize and trash. Frank hates paper. — A"
cards.image_prompt: Hand-scrawled sticky note with numbered list of AWS service names, hurried handwriting, slightly bent corners, single object on dark background

cards.title: Onboarding Step 4: Complete.
cards.description: Alex slaps your shoulder. "Server Room's the last stop. Boot the S3 Locker, you're cleared. Don't reorder the steps. People reorder the steps. Don't." A door at the back of the break room slides open.

cards.title: Coffee Machine Manual
cards.description:
Laminated, sticky, half-covered in espresso splatter:

"NovaCloud Brew-3000 — Powered by Lambda.
• Brew time: 200ms (cold start: 4 minutes, please be patient)
• Beans auto-scale based on Slack volume.
• Do NOT touch the red button. (We don't know what it does. Marcus pressed it once.)"
cards.image_prompt: Laminated coffee machine instruction card, espresso splatter stains, glossy plastic, top-down view, single object on dark background

cards.title: Server Room — S3 Locker
cards.description:
Cold air. Blue LED strips. A wall of server racks hums in harmony. A single terminal stands center-room with five service tiles glowing soft white: EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, LAMBDA. Above it, etched in steel: "INITIALIZE YOUR S3 LOCKER. BOOT ORDER MATTERS."

A reader awaits your activated badge.
cards.image_prompt: Sleek modern server room, towering racks with blue LED lighting, central holographic terminal with five glowing service tiles, cold cinematic lighting, isometric digital illustration

discoveries.label: Tap badge and boot the S3 Locker
Look at the founding photo on the wall

cards.title: S3 Locker Terminal
cards.description: A holographic console with five draggable service tiles. The screen reads: "ARRANGE BOOT ORDER. ONE SHOT."
cards.image_prompt: Holographic touch-screen terminal with five floating AWS service tiles labeled EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, LAMBDA, blue and orange glow, single object on dark background

cards.title: The Founding Photo
cards.description: A grainy framed photo: three founders huddled around a laptop in a garage. Caption: "NovaCloud — Day One. November 2006." The date matches your IAM PIN. (Coincidence? They love that joke.)
cards.image_prompt: Grainy black-and-white framed startup founding photo, three young founders huddled around an old laptop in a garage, dated nameplate, single object on dark background

cards.title: Welcome to the cloud.
cards.description:
The S3 Locker hums green. Five tiles light in sequence — EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, LAMBDA. Confetti pops from a hidden vent. A voice over the PA:

"Welcome to the cloud. You're cleared for access."

Alex sprints in with a NovaCloud t-shirt, a sticker pack, and a high-five. You earned the swag. You earned the badge. You earned the Lambda-powered cold brew.
